newsitem.title: NORWAY: Another all-time high at bullish Oslo Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Another all-time high at bullish Oslo Bourse.

text.p: Norwegian shares surged to another life peak on Thursday on the back of good liquidity and Wall Street gains, dealers said.
Oslo's Total share index rose 0.86 percent to 1,024.10 points -- a record close -- in brisk turnover of 1.1 billion crowns.

"There is a combination of Wall Street and liquidity," one dealer said. "Things are looking good, but we are dependent on international markets. We think investors, both foreign and Norwegian, still want to buy Norwegian shares. Any correction will be linked to international developments, not Norwegian."
The shipping, industry and banking indexes all rose, but the insurance index fell slightly.
Telecommunications company Nera was the most traded share at 101 million crowns, rising 0.67 percent to 299 crowns partly because of a big order for the share, one dealer said.
Industrial group Norsk Hydro, Norway's biggest listed company, was up 0.55 percent at 364.50 crowns.
